rule_texts: When the requirement of a specimen collected within the past 48 hours whose accession matches the current patient is satisfied, assign Route 01 Ready, unless the laboratory has rejected that specimen.

If the requirement of a specimen collected within the past 48 hours whose accession matches the current patient is not satisfied, assign Route 01 Preparation, unless the laboratory has rejected that specimen.
If the laboratory has rejected that specimen, assign Route 01 Exception; this exception takes precedence over the other two branches.
newness: New subject-specific workflow propositions and narratives; logical operators are intentionally shared with earlier experiments.

rule_texts: When the requirement of the patient's own callback permission is still active and was recorded within the past 30 days is satisfied, assign Route 02 Ready, unless the patient has asked the service to suspend calls.

If the requirement of the patient's own callback permission is still active and was recorded within the past 30 days is not satisfied, assign Route 02 Preparation, unless the patient has asked the service to suspend calls.
If the patient has asked the service to suspend calls, assign Route 02 Exception; this exception takes precedence over the other two branches.
newness: New subject-specific workflow propositions and narratives; logical operators are intentionally shared with earlier experiments.

rule_texts: When the requirement of the patient has no implanted device and the current equipment questionnaire is complete is satisfied, assign Route 03 Ready, unless a specialist review is required and no signed review waiver is in force.

If the requirement of the patient has no implanted device and the current equipment questionnaire is complete is not satisfied, assign Route 03 Preparation, unless a specialist review is required and no signed review waiver is in force.
If a specialist review is required and no signed review waiver is in force, assign Route 03 Exception; this exception takes precedence over the other two branches.
newness: New subject-specific workflow propositions and narratives; logical operators are intentionally shared with earlier experiments.

name_zh: 用药清单复核与后续出院
rule_texts: When the requirement of the patient's medication list has been verified today and the patient brought their own medication containers is satisfied, assign Route 04 Ready, unless the patient has had a hospital discharge after that verification.

If the requirement of the patient's medication list has been verified today and the patient brought their own medication containers is not satisfied, assign Route 04 Preparation, unless the patient has had a hospital discharge after that verification.
If the patient has had a hospital discharge after that verification, assign Route 04 Exception; this exception takes precedence over the other two branches.

name_zh: 结果通知渠道与临时限制
rule_texts: When the requirement of the patient currently permits either telephone notification or portal notification is satisfied, assign Route 05 Ready, unless a temporary communication restriction is active on the patient's account.

If the requirement of the patient currently permits either telephone notification or portal notification is not satisfied, assign Route 05 Preparation, unless a temporary communication restriction is active on the patient's account.
If a temporary communication restriction is active on the patient's account, assign Route 05 Exception; this exception takes precedence over the other two branches.

name_zh: 远程设备所属人与最近上传
rule_texts: When the requirement of the uploaded readings come from a device assigned to this patient and were uploaded within the past 24 hours is satisfied, assign Route 06 Ready, unless the device is currently listed as recalled.

If the requirement of the uploaded readings come from a device assigned to this patient and were uploaded within the past 24 hours is not satisfied, assign Route 06 Preparation, unless the device is currently listed as recalled.
If the device is currently listed as recalled, assign Route 06 Exception; this exception takes precedence over the other two branches.
newness: New subject-specific workflow propositions and narratives; logical operators are intentionally shared with earlier experiments.

rule_texts: When the requirement of the patient requests an interpreter and a professional interpreter for the requested language is available is satisfied, assign Route 07 Ready, unless the patient has subsequently declined professional interpretation for this appointment.

If the requirement of the patient requests an interpreter and a professional interpreter for the requested language is available is not satisfied, assign Route 07 Preparation, unless the patient has subsequently declined professional interpretation for this appointment.
If the patient has subsequently declined professional interpretation for this appointment, assign Route 07 Exception; this exception takes precedence over the other two branches.

rule_texts: When the requirement of the current form was signed either by the patient or by the patient's legally authorized representative is satisfied, assign Route 08 Ready, unless permission on this form was withdrawn after it was signed.

If the requirement of the current form was signed either by the patient or by the patient's legally authorized representative is not satisfied, assign Route 08 Preparation, unless permission on this form was withdrawn after it was signed.
If permission on this form was withdrawn after it was signed, assign Route 08 Exception; this exception takes precedence over the other two branches.

name_zh: 当前签到离场与房间例外
rule_texts: When the requirement of the patient has checked in for today's appointment and has not left the facility since checking in is satisfied, assign Route 09 Ready, unless the assigned room is closed and no approved replacement room is available.

If the requirement of the patient has checked in for today's appointment and has not left the facility since checking in is not satisfied, assign Route 09 Preparation, unless the assigned room is closed and no approved replacement room is available.
If the assigned room is closed and no approved replacement room is available, assign Route 09 Exception; this exception takes precedence over the other two branches.

name_zh: 存档玻片归属与当前借出
rule_texts: When the requirement of the archived slides belong to this patient and the original slides are available in the archive is satisfied, assign Route 10 Ready, unless the slides are currently on loan to another service.

If the requirement of the archived slides belong to this patient and the original slides are available in the archive is not satisfied, assign Route 10 Preparation, unless the slides are currently on loan to another service.
If the slides are currently on loan to another service, assign Route 10 Exception; this exception takes precedence over the other two branches.

name_zh: 交通安排与本人留宿请求
rule_texts: When the requirement of either a driver is confirmed for the patient or independent travel has been administratively approved is satisfied, assign Route 11 Ready, unless the patient has requested an overnight accommodation booking.

If the requirement of either a driver is confirmed for the patient or independent travel has been administratively approved is not satisfied, assign Route 11 Preparation, unless the patient has requested an overnight accommodation booking.
If the patient has requested an overnight accommodation booking, assign Route 11 Exception; this exception takes precedence over the other two branches.

name_zh: 日记时间与复核后新增记录
rule_texts: When the requirement of the patient's own diary contains entries on two consecutive days and the patient has requested a discussion is satisfied, assign Route 12 Ready, unless the current diary was already reviewed and no new entry has been added after that review.

If the requirement of the patient's own diary contains entries on two consecutive days and the patient has requested a discussion is not satisfied, assign Route 12 Preparation, unless the current diary was already reviewed and no new entry has been added after that review.
If the current diary was already reviewed and no new entry has been added after that review, assign Route 12 Exception; this exception takes precedence over the other two branches.
